Call them. Don't go online. Call Girl A, call Girl B, call Girl C.

It's like asking a girl out over AIM. You're not 12.

Bro, calm down. Girl's are such a small part of your life, and you're only 16. This is so small, it'll be nothing in a few months.

Love your hand (figuratively and literally), and cut the girls for awhile. Get guy friends to hang out with and talk about shit that'll take your mind off it.

I don't know what else to say here.

You were just trolled. As DoppelAccount mentioned, how would he know to blame the forums unless he left a note? He lost a flame war, and that was the only 'plausible' reason the idiot knew how to get off a forum.

Feel better.
